title: Daily Routine
summary: A teenager describes a typical weekday from waking up to going to bed, using present-simple time markers.
description: A beginner-friendly monologue with short conversational interjections. Learners hear sequencing words (then, after that, in the evening) and time expressions (at seven o'clock, at half past eight).

vocabulary.definition: to stop sleeping and open your eyes
to eat the first meal of the day
later than something; following it in time
to lie down to sleep at night

dialogue.text: So, Tom, what time do you usually wake up?
I wake up at seven o'clock on weekdays.
And what do you do first?
I have breakfast with my family. Then I brush my teeth.
When do you go to school?
I go to school at half past eight. I take the bus.
After school, I do my homework and then I have dinner. I go to bed at ten.

questions.q: When does Tom wake up on weekdays?
How does Tom go to school?
What does Tom do first in the morning?

trueFalse.statement: Tom wakes up at seven on weekends too.
trueFalse.explanation: Tom says he wakes up at seven 'on weekdays'.

trueFalse.statement: Tom does his homework before dinner.
trueFalse.explanation: He says 'After school, I do my homework and then I have dinner.'

teacherTips: Drill the time expressions (at seven o'clock, at half past eight) before listening.
Have students fill in a daily-routine chart while listening — first column for Tom, second column for themselves.
Use this as a follow-up writing prompt: 'Write five sentences about your daily routine.'

es.title: Rutina diaria
es.summary: Un adolescente describe un día laborable típico, desde que se despierta hasta que se acuesta, usando marcadores temporales en presente simple.
es.description: Un monólogo apto para principiantes con breves intervenciones conversacionales. Los estudiantes oyen palabras de secuenciación (then, after that, in the evening) y expresiones de tiempo (at seven o'clock, at half past eight).

vocabulary.definition: dejar de dormir y abrir los ojos
comer la primera comida del día
algo que haces casi todos los días
más tarde que algo; siguiéndolo en el tiempo
tumbarse para dormir por la noche

questions.q: ¿A qué hora se despierta Tom los días laborables?
¿Qué hace Tom primero por la mañana?

trueFalse.statement: Tom se despierta a las siete también los fines de semana.
trueFalse.explanation: Tom dice que se despierta a las siete 'on weekdays' (los días laborables).

trueFalse.statement: Tom hace los deberes antes de cenar.
trueFalse.explanation: Dice 'After school, I do my homework and then I have dinner'.

teacherTips: Practica antes las expresiones de tiempo (at seven o'clock, at half past eight).
Pide a los estudiantes que completen una tabla de rutina mientras escuchan — primera columna para Tom, segunda para ellos mismos.
Usa esto como ejercicio de escritura: 'Escribe cinco frases sobre tu rutina diaria'.
